description: The relation types of ADR-040 D3. ends: the [from, to] class pairs a relation may join; a subclass of either end may stand in it (placed-in for asset holds for a server). cardinality: n:1 — a from object has one current relation of the type (a new one closes the old); 1:n — a to object has one; 1:1 — both; n:m — neither.

allocated-to.description: A resource is allocated to a CI: the box a node runs on, for now. Later a pool's allocation (O10).

runs-on.description: A guest on its machine; software on the node it runs in; a pool or datastore on its node.

part-of.description: A port is part of its asset (D9).

placed-in.description: An asset stands in a rack or a room; a rack in a room.

at.description: A room is at a location; a CI is at one (a satellite's, recorded; a site's primary).

connects.description: A cable between two ports (seen or recorded; kind, label, origin, side and the observed link speed are its attributes); a wifi port to an SSID.

member-of.description: A node in a cluster or an environment; a user in a group; an address in a zone.

depends-on.description: A node depends on a service (the module's dependsOn).

provides.description: A node provides a service (the module's provides).

serves.description: A zone serves an environment; a proxy route a service.

owned-by.description: An environment or a group is owned by an organization; an organization by its parent; an asset by the site.

backs-up.description: A datastore backs up a guest or a machine; a backup peer the site.
